label: А
description: Soft contrast and topic-shift sentences that use Russian 'a' naturally.

missions.phrase: Я сейчас дома, а ты ещё на работе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Parallel contrast. 1. 'А' sets two locations side by side. 2. 'Сейчас' and 'ещё' add a real-life time frame. 3. This is a very common spoken pattern.

missions.phrase: Он пьёт зелёный чай, а она любит кофе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Light contrast. 1. 'А' links two different preferences. 2. The added objects make the clauses fuller. 3. The repeating frame is easy for type-speed practice.

missions.phrase: Мы идём пешком, а они едут на автобусе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion contrast. 1. The first clause uses walking. 2. 'Едут на автобусе' specifies the vehicle motion. 3. 'А' keeps the contrast smooth rather than sharp.

missions.phrase: Это не наш дом, а соседняя школа.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Corrective contrast. 1. 'Не наш дом' sets up a false guess. 2. 'А соседняя школа' corrects it. 3. This is a very important everyday Russian pattern.

missions.phrase: Я читаю интересную книгу, а ты пишешь письмо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Split activity. 1. 'А' contrasts two simultaneous actions. 2. Each verb gets its own object. 3. The verbs still match their subjects cleanly.

missions.phrase: У меня есть холодная вода, а у тебя её нет.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Possession contrast. 1. 'У меня есть' is positive possession. 2. 'У тебя её нет' is the negative mirror. 3. Great for case and genitive-negation practice.

missions.phrase: Входная дверь открыта, а окно плотно закрыто.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Opposed states. 1. Two short-form adjectives make the contrast crisp. 2. 'Открыта' and 'закрыто' are easy to compare. 3. The extra words paint a clear scene.

missions.phrase: Сегодня на улице холодно, а вчера было тепло.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Time-based contrast. 1. 'Сегодня' and 'вчера' anchor the comparison. 2. 'Было тепло' gives a past-state frame. 3. This sentence is useful for weather talk.

missions.phrase: Мой друг старший, а его брат младший.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Family comparison. 1. 'Старший' and 'младший' are common age labels. 2. 'А' links the two relatives as a natural pair. 3. The possessives make it concrete and reusable.

missions.phrase: Здесь в парке тихо, а там на площади шумно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Environmental contrast. 1. 'Здесь' and 'там' give a clear spatial split. 2. 'Тихо' and 'шумно' are a useful adjective pair. 3. The locations ground the comparison.
